@billionappl @RancidPotato @theonevortex @cryptomanran @dogecoin @SiaTechHQ You cannot use as a medium of exchange a crypto that cannot at least retain its value.
@RancidPotato @billionappl @theonevortex @cryptomanran @dogecoin @SiaTechHQ I would insert “Reliable” rather than “Real” though.

@RancidPotato @billionappl @theonevortex @cryptomanran @dogecoin @SiaTechHQ I’m not being defensive I am merely driving a point;

THERE IS NO USE FOR A CRYPTO TO THE INVESTOR IF IT CANNOT AT LEAST RETAIN ITS VALUE B/W THE TIME OF PURCHASE & TIME OF SALE.

@RancidPotato @billionappl @theonevortex @cryptomanran @dogecoin @SiaTechHQ Why did they sell at a loss? Investing is about staying the course and not jumping ship at the first sight of danger. Especially if you know anything about the underlying asset. Just because some idiot scalped and lost money doesn’t mean Bitcoin is a bad investment.

@billionappl @theonevortex @cryptomanran @dogecoin @SiaTechHQ Not true. Store of Value is about keeping part of your wealth in an asset that will at least retain its value for the term you need it to.

@billionappl @theonevortex @cryptomanran @dogecoin @SiaTechHQ Name a crypto in the top 100 for the past 367 days that doesn’t qualify as a store of value. My point is; the point of a cryptocurrency’s existence should be at least to retain its value if not accumulate. Otherwise what’s the point eh?
@billionappl @theonevortex @cryptomanran @dogecoin @SiaTechHQ I didn’t imply they were limited to only one function.
@Cointelegraph ‘However, the marketing campaign appears to be unavailable to Dogecoin (DOGE) fanatics outside of the United States.’ 💀💀
